description: A PDF read page by page: each page drawn to a picture, read by the one worker, and the per-page searchable PDFs joined in order.

notes.text: Starts every page after the first in the text, as Tesseract's own text output does.
One searchable PDF, when asked for.
Tesseract sizes a page from the picture's resolution, which a rendered PNG doesn't carry: give it the source page's size back.
